variants.specifics: Brackenford: A townsman sends the player to Reeve Halvard in the Moot Hall; Halvard briefs him on Red Corwin in the Crow Hill watchtower and gives him the town's scrolls.

herald.speaker: Townsman
herald.text: The north gate's shut and nobody can get the flour out to market! If you're looking for work, Reeve Halvard is in the Moot Hall. Go and see him.

opening.speaker: Halvard
opening.text:
So, you're the one Garrick told me about. Good! Brackenford has need of you, lad.

Red Corwin and his band of cutthroats have taken the old watchtower on Crow Hill. From up there they see every cart on the north road, and they rob every one. I have shut the north gate, and now Brackenford is besieged in all but name!

Corwin must be removed. Go up Crow Hill, take back the tower and bring Corwin down, by whatever means. Garrick will open the gate for you.

Take these scrolls. They are the town's own, kept in the Moot Hall for darker days than this. Use them well.

reminder.speaker: Halvard
reminder.text: Every day Corwin sits in that tower, Brackenford grows poorer. Go!

journal.text: Take back the watchtower on Crow Hill from Red Corwin.

variants.specifics: Bormunt: Mott points the player to Guildmaster Brannoc in the Guild Hall; Brannoc gives the key to the lower gate and sends him against Skarn's Trolls at the Great Lift.

herald.speaker: Mott
herald.text: The Lift's stuck again. Can't dig, can't get home. If you're looking for somebody important, Guildmaster Brannoc's in the Guild Hall.

opening.speaker: Brannoc
opening.text:
So Yorrel sent you. Good. You've come at a black hour for Bormunt.

The warlock Skarn has brought the Trolls up out of the deep caves. They've taken the Great Lift -- and half our miners are trapped below with them!

By the authority of the Miners' Guild, I deputate you to go down and break their hold on the Lift. Here is the key to the lower gate. Find our miners. And if Skarn shows his face, kill him!

reminder.speaker: Brannoc
reminder.text: You have the key. Why are you still standing in my hall? Go!

journal.text: Break the Trolls' hold on the Great Lift.

variants.specifics: Oskry: A townsman sends the player to Mayor Brumm in the Long House; Brumm, curt, sends him after Vesra the Bog Witch and gives gold and potions.

herald.speaker: Townsman
herald.text: The dead came up the ladders again last night! You'd better go see Mayor Brumm in the Long House. Quick!

opening.speaker: Mayor Brumm
opening.text:
So, Marrock sent you. Good. There's no time for talk.

Vesra the Bog Witch is raising the drowned dead out of the Blackwater. Every night they climb our ladders, and every night there are more of them. Find her island in the west and destroy her.

Here's 100 gold and some potions. Get what you need in town, then go.

reminder.speaker: Mayor Brumm
reminder.text: Why do you wait, lad? Vesra grows stronger every night!

journal.text: Find Vesra the Bog Witch's island and destroy her.

variants.specifics: Castle Brask: A townsman sends the player to Belloc the War-Mage in the keep, who sends him after the Necromancer Vessk in the old barrows.

herald.speaker: Townsman
herald.text: The Undead came over the north wall again last night! Belloc the War-Mage wants anyone who can fight. He's up in the keep.

opening.speaker: Belloc
opening.text:
So Ostric sent you. Good.

A Necromancer called Vessk is raising the dead from the old barrows north of the castle. Every night more of them come over the wall. Go out through the north postern, find Vessk and destroy him.

Take these spells. You'll need them. Now go, lad.

reminder.speaker: Belloc
reminder.text: Are you still here?! Go! The wall won't hold forever!

journal.text: Destroy the Necromancer Vessk in the old barrows north of the castle.

variants.specifics: Vesk: Joss points the player to Mayor Ostrin, who sends him to the Weeping Isle after the Necromancer Vezzek.

herald.speaker: Joss
herald.text: You're the one Master Odrel sent? Mayor Ostrin is expecting you. Big house at the end of the main dock.

opening.speaker: Mayor Ostrin
opening.text:
Grim tidings, lad. Last night the dead walked up out of Lake Mirrow and dragged some of our fishermen right off the dock. We could hear the poor souls screaming all the way to the Weeping Isle.

It is the Necromancer Vezzek. He has made the Isle his home, and the drowned answer to him now!

By the authorization of this village, I command you to cross to the Weeping Isle and put an end to Vezzek. Ambrus the Ferryman can take you across. Go!

reminder.speaker: Mayor Ostrin
reminder.text: Go! Vezzek grows bolder with every night!

journal.text: Cross to the Weeping Isle and defeat the Necromancer Vezzek.

variants.specifics: Vorne: A townsman points the player to Master Dorrovan on the Lyceum steps; Dorrovan, an old friend of Jorvald who sent the player, hands over scrolls and sends him north against Sarvok in the Observatory on Gallow Ridge.

herald.speaker: Townsman
herald.text: Fireballs over the north wall again last night. Master Dorrovan's been waiting on the Lyceum steps all morning for somebody. Is it you?

opening.speaker: Master Dorrovan
opening.text:
So, you've arrived at last, lad! Jorvald wrote that he was sending me someone. I hope you're as good as he says.

Sarvok the Renegade was a master of this Lyceum until we threw him out for meddling in the Black Arts. Now he holds the old Observatory on Gallow Ridge, north of town, with Imps and Golems at his beck and call. Every night he steals more of our magic.

Take these scrolls. They'll serve you well. Go north, find Sarvok and put an end to his madness! Torrik will open the gate for you.

reminder.speaker: Master Dorrovan
reminder.text: Go, lad! The Lyceum cannot hold out much longer!

journal.text: Go to the Observatory on Gallow Ridge and stop Sarvok the Renegade.

variants.specifics: Fort Kholm: Hagen points the player to Marshal Odric on the wall; Odric, Faldrin's old friend, gives him a sword and sends him up to the Glacier Crypts after Ulvana.

herald.speaker: Hagen
herald.text: Marshal Odric's been pacing the wall all morning, waiting on somebody from the lowlands. That'd be you, I expect.

opening.speaker: Marshal Odric
opening.text:
So, you have arrived at last, lad! Faldrin's letter came up the pass ahead of you. He speaks well of you.

Hear me. The Necromancer Ulvana -- curse her name -- has woken the dead of the Glacier Crypts, high above the fort. Every night her Undead come down Wyrmtooth Pass and every night we drive them back. My men grow cold and weary.

Take this sword, it served me well in younger days. Climb to the Crypts and put an end to Ulvana, or Fort Kholm will not see the spring!

reminder.speaker: Marshal Odric
reminder.text: The Crypts, lad! Go! My men cannot hold the wall forever!

journal.text: Climb to the Glacier Crypts and destroy the Necromancer Ulvana.

variants.specifics: Fornath: Harl points the player to Master Kasrak, the town's old warlord and an old friend of Tobrin; Kasrak gives a sword and sends him up the Mountain Road against Gorvane.

herald.speaker: Harl
herald.text: Are you the one Tobrin sent? Master Kasrak has been asking for you since sunup! Go on up to the Anvil Hall, quick!

opening.speaker: Kasrak
opening.text:
So, Tobrin sent you. Good. He spoke highly of you, lad, and we have need of every brave arm. The nefarious warlock Gorvane has marched his Ogres up the mountain and seized the Black Smeltery. Every bar of iron in Fornath comes out of that smeltery -- every one!

Gorvane means to turn our own furnaces against us. Once his Ogres are armed with Fornath steel, they will come down the mountain and nothing in the land will stand before them.

Take this sword. It was forged in this hall and it has never failed me. Go up the Mountain Road to the Black Smeltery and drive Gorvane out. Fornath's fires are in your hands!

reminder.speaker: Kasrak
reminder.text: Still here, lad? Every hour you tarry, Gorvane's Ogres forge another blade!

journal.text: Drive Gorvane and his Ogres from the Black Smeltery.

variants.specifics: Wendle Cross: Rudd points the player to Telmarq the Arch-Wizard, an old friend of Pellam the Caravan Master, who gives him spell scrolls and sends him after the warlock Zelloc at Fort Skarrow.

herald.speaker: Rudd
herald.text: There were Skeletons on the Grey Moor again last night! Telmarq the Arch-Wizard wants you up at his tower right away.

opening.speaker: Telmarq
opening.text:
So! You are the one Pellam wrote to me about. Come in, come in, lad. I had begun to fear Zelloc's Skeletons had got you on the road.

Hear me well. Zelloc is a warlock of the foulest sort. He has taken old Fort Skarrow, out on the Grey Moor, and there he raises the dead of an ancient battle. Every night his army grows. Already the north road is lost, and if he is not stopped Wendle Cross will be the next to fall!

I am too old for such a journey, more's the pity. Take these spell scrolls, they are the best I have. Cross the Grey Moor, find Fort Skarrow and put an end to Zelloc's abominable work. Go now, and may the stars watch over you!

reminder.speaker: Telmarq
reminder.text: Why do you dawdle? Zelloc's army grows with every night!

journal.text: Find Fort Skarrow on the Grey Moor and stop the warlock Zelloc.

variants.specifics: Hestle: Greda points the player to Mayor Dulvane in the Town Hall, who hands him a sword and sends him to drive the Ogres from the granary fort on Kroth Hill.

herald.speaker: Greda
herald.text: Mayor Dulvane has been calling for help all morning! The Town Hall is in the middle of the village.

opening.speaker: Mayor Dulvane
opening.text:
So Vellis sent you. Good. There's no time for talk.

The Ogres have taken the old granary fort on Kroth Hill -- our own grain, in our own fort! Every night they come down and rob the farms.

Take this sword. Go up the hill and drive them out. Tobb will open the north gate for you.

journal.text: Drive the Ogres out of the granary fort on Kroth Hill.
